logo.title: Text to Logo
logo.heading: Describe a mark, get an
logo.subtitle: Recraft and Ideogram draw real vectors: layers, paths and clean geometry that open in Figma or Illustrator. Or let a chat model (Gemini, Claude, GPT) write the SVG by hand for a fraction of the price, then refine it with a sentence. Pick a brand palette, ask for a few candidates, then export the one you like as PNG, PDF, favicon or app icons for free.
logo.placeholder: Describe the logo: subject, style and mood, for example a minimal fox head mark, geometric, two colours

starters.label: Geometric fox head mark
starters.prompt: Minimal geometric fox head logo mark, flat vector, two colours, negative space, no text

starters.label: Coffee roaster badge
starters.prompt: Circular badge logo for a coffee roaster, a single coffee bean in the centre, thin line details, vintage but clean, no text

starters.label: Soft rounded app icon
starters.prompt: Friendly app icon of a paper plane, rounded shapes, flat colour, subtle gradient, centered on a plain background

icons.title: Icon Set
icons.heading: One style, a whole
icons.subtitle: Write the style once and list the icons you need, one per line. Every name runs with the same style words and palette, drawn by Recraft or Ideogram or written as clean paths by a chat model, and the finished set exports as an SVG sprite or a zip of single files.
icons.placeholder: Style for every icon, for example thin line icons, 2px stroke, rounded corners, single colour

starters.label: Thin line, rounded
starters.prompt: Thin line icon, 2px stroke, rounded corners and caps, single colour, 24px grid

starters.label: Filled duotone
starters.prompt: Filled duotone icon, bold simple shapes, two tones of one colour, soft corners

starters.label: Hand-drawn marker
starters.prompt: Hand-drawn marker icon, slightly uneven lines, playful, monochrome

vectorize.title: Vectorize
vectorize.heading: Trace any image into a
vectorize.subtitle: Drop in a PNG, JPG or WebP, or pick a result from Image Studio. Image2SVG traces geometry for a fraction of a cent, Recraft keeps shapes smooth and editable, Ideogram redraws the picture as vector art. You get the original and the SVG side by side.
vectorize.placeholder: Add an image above, choose a tracer, then vectorize.

controls.modelHint: Native vector models draw richer illustration; chat models write cleaner paths for icons, geometric marks and wordmarks, at a fraction of the price.
controls.advancedHint: Show the less common tracing knobs

palette.title: Brand palette
palette.hint: Recraft takes these colours directly. Other models get them written into the prompt.

vectorize.dropHint: PNG, JPG or WebP. Flat art, logos and screenshots trace best.

refine.title: Refine with {model}
refine.hint: Say what to change. The current SVG goes back to the same model with your instruction, and the answer is saved as a new entry linked to this one.
refine.placeholder: make the mark bolder, remove the gradient
